:::{#def-cv-se-indexed}
#### Fold-based standard error of a named procedure

The **fold-based standard error of procedure** $g$, $\cvseof{g}$,
is the [fold-based standard error](#def-cv-se) of @eq-cv-se,
with each [fold mean squared error](#def-fold-mse) $\foldmse{j}$
computed from the [fold-out rule](#def-fold-out-rule) that $g$ produces:

$$
\cvseof{g} \eqdef \frac{\hSD{\foldmse{1}, \ldots, \foldmse{k}}}{\sqrt{k}}.
$$ {#eq-cv-se-indexed}

:::
